title: Authorization confirmation timeline event added
description: Authorization confirmation event added to user's timeline. For more information, see [Timeline events overview](https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/docs/timeline-overview).

account_id.title: User's account ID at Pismo Platform

cardholder_currency_rate.title: Factor used in the conversion from transaction to cardholder billing amount

cardholderbilling_amount.title: Indicates the transaction amount in the issuer’s currency

contract_amount.title: Total amount of the transaction, including all taxes and fees, in the cardholder currency

currency_code.title: Currency code of the place where the transaction was done. ISO_4217 numeric code

currency_literal.title: Currency code country iso code. ISO3166-1 literal 3-digit code

entry_mode.title: Indicates which entry mode code was used in the transaction

entry_mode_literal.title: Indicates the name of the entry mode used in the transaction

installments.title: List of installments of this authorization

interest_rate.title: Contains the rate that the issuer assesses the cardholder for the installment payment

is_referral.title: Indicates whether the transaction is suspected of fraud

local_amount.title: Amount of funds the cardholder requested in the local currency of the acquirer or source location of the transaction

merchant_category_code.title: Identifies the card acceptor that defines the point of the transaction in both local and interchange environments

merchant_category_group.title: Mapped group based on category code

merchant_state_or_country.title: State or country field from merchant

tid.title: Transaction identifier received on the authorization message.
tid.description: This identifier is generated by the Card Network. It will be null in case where the card network doesn't send this value.

org_operation.title: Includes the processing code of the authorization

processing_code.title: Describes the effect of a transaction on the customer account and the type of accounts affected

pre_authorization.title: Define whether it is a pre-authorization request or not

principal_amount.title: Amount of transaction without taxes and fees

response_code.title: Defines the disposition of a previous message or an action taken as a result of receipt of a previous message

settlement_currency_amount.title: Amount of funds to be transferred between the acquirer and the issuer equal to the transaction amount in the settlement currency

settlement_currency_code.title: Currency code defined by the issuer

settlement_currency_literal.title: Currency code country description for settlement

settlement_currency_rate.title: Factor used in the conversion from transaction to settlement amount

soft_descriptor.title: Merchant description including name, city and country code

nsu.title: Message initiator assigns to uniquely identify a transaction

retrieval_reference_number.title: Document reference number assigned by the acquirer

authorization_code.title: Transaction response ID code assigned by authorizing institution

airport_tax.title: Amount of airport tax on the authorization

ledger_update_id.title: Id of update performed on Ledger API
ledger_update_id.description: Id returned by the Ledger API which identifies the account limit impact. This field may be null since some transactions generate timeline but doesn't have any financial impact.

card_acceptor_id.title: Identifies the card acceptor that defines the point of the transaction in both local and interchange environments

cash_back_amount.title: Amount of Cash Back of the Authorization
cash_back_amount.description: In purchase with cash back or POS withdrawal, this is the amount related to the withdrawal/cash back. The principal amount is the sum of this amount with the purchase amount.

token_information.title: Token information for tokenized authorizations
token_information.description: Contains information of the token which did authenticate authorization

id.title: Token ID
id.description: The sequential internal identifier that is generated automatically

requestor_id.title: Requestor ID
requestor_id.description: A string that identifies the wallet which request the token provisioning

type.title: Token Type
type.description: A string that identifies the type of the token

network_token.title: Network Token
network_token.description: Token identifier as coming from the network. For Visa requests, this field represents the value received in the F123, Usage 2, Dataset ID 68 (Token Data), Tag 01. For Mastercard requests, it is DE48, SE 33 PanMappingFileInformation, SF2 Account Number.

network_requestor_id.title: Network Requestor ID
network_requestor_id.description: A string that identifies the wallet which request the token provisioning, as coming from the network. For Visa requests, this field represents the value received in the F123, Usage 2, Dataset ID 68 (Token Data), Tag 03. For Mastercard requests, it is DE48, SE 33 PanMappingFileInformation, SF6 Token Requestor ID.

cancelled_by_elapsed_time.title: Cancelled by Elapsed Time
cancelled_by_elapsed_time.description: This flag indicates whether a authorization was cancelled because of the elapsed time without a confirmation message. If so, its value will be 'true'. If the authorization was cancelled by the acquirer, its value will be false. For events other than Cancellation timelines, its value will be 'null'.

metadata.title: Metadata from Anti Fraud
metadata.description: Contains any valid json sent into the response of the Anti Fraud request. This information is saved and sent into this event as it was received into the platform, without any processing over it.

validation_results.title: Validation results
validation_results.description: Contains all executed validations with details for each result.

name.title: Validation name
name.description: The name which identifies the validation.

status.title: Validation status
status.description: Represents the result of the validation.

reason.title: Validation reason
reason.description: Identifies the reason why a validation has that result.

description.title: Description
description.description: Contains a more detailed information about the validation result.

additional_data.title: Additional Data
additional_data.description: Contains additional information that is relevant to identify how the validation was performed. Every validation will have its own additional data, so please refer to Pismo Developers Guide to identify every possibility.

dcc.title: Flag indicating a DCC authorization
dcc.description: This flag identifies if an authorization is DCC. This flag is true when the local amount is in the cardholder currency but the Merchant is International. It identifies that even though the authorization is in the local currency, it was considered an International authorization.

incoming_response_code.title: Incoming Response Code from Card Network
incoming_response_code.description: This field represents the value received in the field 39 of the Card Network specification and indicates the Response Code they assigned to this authorization. For cancellation messages, if present, this value may indicate the reason of the cancellation.

incoming_authorization_code.title: Incoming Authorization Code from Card Network
incoming_authorization_code.description: This field represents the value received in the field 38 of the Card Network specification and indicates the Authorization Code they assigned to this authorization.

program_id.title: Program ID used in the authorization.
program_id.description: This field represents the internal id of the Program of the card used on this authorization.
